# Move AI

> > Move AI provides markerless motion capture technology powered by AI, enabling creators to generate 3D character animation from video without suits or markers.

Move AI offers two primary products: Move One for single-camera iPhone-based mocap and Move Pro for multi-camera professional production workflows. The platform serves VFX artists, animators, and game developers with tools for hand tracking, keyframe animation, and high-fidelity motion capture.

## Key Topics

- markerless motion capture
- AI-powered animation
- single-camera mocap
- multi-camera mocap
- hand tracking
- 3D character animation
- mobile mocap (iPhone/iPad)
- VFX workflow
- high-fidelity tracking
- professional mocap
- keyframe animation
- on-premise processing
- crowd simulation
- Gen 2 technology

## Core Products

- [Move One](https://www.move.ai/move-one): Move One: Single-camera markerless mocap for iPhone with AI animation
- [Move Pro](https://www.move.ai/move-pro): Move Pro: Multi-camera professional mocap with high-fidelity tracking
